description: This file defines the PrefixSpan class and related parameters for mining frequent sequential patterns using the PrefixSpan algorithm in Apache Spark's MLlib. It includes parameter definitions, the main class implementation, and a method to find frequent sequential patterns in a dataset.

classes.name: PrefixSpan
classes.description: A class implementing the PrefixSpan algorithm for mining frequent sequential patterns, with configurable parameters and a method to find patterns in datasets.

classes.name: PrefixSpanParams
classes.description: A trait defining parameters for the PrefixSpan algorithm, such as minSupport, maxPatternLength, maxLocalProjDBSize, and sequenceCol.

methods.name: findFrequentSequentialPatterns
methods.description: Finds all frequent sequential patterns in the input dataset, returning a DataFrame with sequences and their frequencies.

methods.name: setMinSupport
methods.description: Sets the minimum support parameter for the PrefixSpan algorithm.

methods.name: setMaxPatternLength
methods.description: Sets the maximum pattern length parameter.

methods.name: setMaxLocalProjDBSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum size of the projected database.

methods.name: setSequenceCol
methods.description: Sets the name of the sequence column in the dataset.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the PrefixSpan instance with optional extra parameters.
